nameEn: Distilling, rectifying and blending of spirits
description: This class includes the manufacture of distilled, rectified and blended spirits such as whisky, brandy, gin, vodka, rum and liqueurs.
includes: manufacture of distilled, rectified and blended spirits: whisky, brandy, gin, rum, vodka
excludes: manufacture of ethyl alcohol by fermentation, see 2011
manufacture of cider and other fruit wines, see 1102
